observations:
Torah #29 yields 6 well-defined packages from 38 bechina edges across 46 nodes, covering 10 raw connected components that reduce to 6 after principled merging. No cluster of 3 or more bechina-connected concepts in the source text exists independently outside these 6 packages.

Candidate clusters examined and rejected:

1. WINE/BLOOD/SINEWS (יין, גידין, דמים in their negative aspect): The concept יין as a bechina of גידין/התגברות הדמים is present in section ח, but יין connects directly to Package 4 (dam nidda/pgam cluster) as another face of the corrupting blood-principle. It does not form an independent domain — it is the same essential nature as dam nidda (the text says אחריתו דם, its end is blood). Addition to Package 4 is the correct classification.

2. WHITENING/RECTIFICATION (לבנונית, חלב, 'דם נעכר ונעשה חלב'): The transformation of blood into milk (לבנונית) appears repeatedly as a metaphor for tikun. However, this is not a separate conceptual domain but rather the directional movement from Package 4 (evil blood) toward Package 1 (tikun/rectification). It is an eitza dynamic between the packages, not a new bechina cluster in its own right. 'ونוزלים מן לבנון' belongs with Package 1 as the expression of whitening-rectification.

3. SINEWS/PROHIBITIONS (שסה גידין, שסה לאוין): These two have a bechina relationship ('the 365 prohibitions are suspended in the 365 sinews') but they connect directly to Package 1 through כלליות הגידין. They are the concrete substrate of the tikun-covenant, not an independent domain. Two nodes do not constitute a new package.

4. MASHAA UMATAN (משא ומתן, צדקה as tikkun of commerce): The commerce/trade domain appears in section ט with explicit bechina language, but in the dataset צדקה is already in Package 1 (as a bechina of כלליות הגידין). The teaching treats משא ומתן באמונה as the path to tzedaka which is the tikun — this is eitza, not a separate bechina cluster. The concept 'משא ומתן' itself has only eitza edges (ref=29) in the dataset.

5. MOCHIN STRUCTURES (חכמה, בינה, אב/אם as mochin): The text states 'the mochin are father in wisdom and mother in binah.' However, these are passing references within the mochin section (the eagle guards the goslings = the mochin that were previously stolen). Chokhmah and Binah as אב/אם are universally-used structural terms that appear across hundreds of Torahs. They do not form a new Torah #29-specific package; they are already embedded within the mochin cluster (Package 2).

Conclusion: All bechina-language concepts in Torah #29's source text are accountable within the 6 proposed packages. The teaching is architecturally clean: one good tikun-domain (Package 1), one structural domain (Package 2), one holy malkhut/speech domain (Package 3), one evil blood/flaw domain (Package 4), one evil time/power domain (Package 5), and one heavenly-sustenance domain (Package 6). The good/evil mirror is clearly present: Package 3 (holy malkhut, white garments) mirrors Package 4 (evil blood, stained garments); Package 1 (tikun/tzaddik) mirrors Package 5 (evil maidservant/sitra achra). Package 6 (manna) is the reward-expression of Package 1's tikun.
